name: Fixed-threshold constraint-aware Sugeno, held-out calibration and test
conditions: The previous constraint checks plus repair for numeric and written centuries and decades. No new LLM call for checks.
train: Prior P3 100 training questions, same five-fold ridge selection, fixed Sugeno sigmoid memberships

sample.exclusions: P0/P1/P3/P5 history and the earlier fresh 40
sample.context: 30 passages per bridge question, exact prior P1 donor index and construction

threshold_calibration.old: Among score-ordered prefixes of length 0 to 8, maximize calibration HotpotQA answer F1 gain, then minimize added Qwen answer input tokens
threshold_calibration.repaired: Apply the same search, with an added-token cap of the selected old policy's calibration spend
threshold_calibration.tie_break: Fewer triggers, then stable qid hash seed 42 for individual scores
threshold_calibration.fixed_threshold_test: Rank boundary tuple from calibration; evaluate per question independently. No score normalization or top-k based on test data.

success: Test HotpotQA F1(repaired) > F1(old) and mean measured Qwen answer input tokens(repaired) <= mean(old)
notes: Top-2 first response, original 2+4 if triggered, retain A if B unusable; only Qwen answering tokens counted. No new sentence selection or latency claim. Calibration and test are disjoint. Gold never goes to inference host.
